blurb: Flour Power Cooking Studios provides hands-on cooking experiences for all ages, including birthday parties, weekly classes, camps, adult classes, corporate events, kids' night out, and etiquette classes. Their camps teach cooking skills, creativity, teamwork, and confidence, with expert instructors guiding participants. They aim to foster a lifelong love of cooking in a fun and safe environment.
extraNote: Camp cancellation requires 30 days written notice for refund less $40 fee; no refunds within 30 days of camp start · Single-day camp tuition is non-refundable but transferable to a friend if notified · Corporate event cancellations less than 30 days before event forfeit deposit
